CustomField.label: Is Advance Allowed
CustomField.description: Backs the Advance Stage button's visibility on the LOI record page. True when the generic one-hop advance is legitimate: not at the terminal Completed stage, not at Sent (where the named Counter and Completed buttons take over the branch), not at Prepare/Review unless the LOI is Approved, and not while an approval is pending. Kept as a formula so the visibility rule is a pure chain of ANDs and so the same expression can back a validation rule that enforces it server-side.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: System field. True when the Advance Stage button should be available on this LOI. It turns off at Sent, where Counter and Completed replace it, and at Prepare/Review until the LOI has been approved.
CustomField.formula: AND( TEXT(Stage__c) <> "Completed", TEXT(Stage__c) <> "Sent", OR( TEXT(Stage__c) <> "Prepare/Review", TEXT(LOI_Status__c) = "Approved" ), TEXT(LOI_Status__c) <> "Pending Approval" )
